title: Common providers: Spain
coverage: Complete for the national fixed and mobile operators, the regional cable operators and the main wholesale fibre networks; local fibre operators and business ISPs are partial.
missing: Local cable and fibre operators (the regulator's register holds several thousand)
AS numbers for Onivia and Reintel (none confirmed: they sell no internet service)
A website for Aire Networks (it did not answer)

sources.name: CNMC: Registro de Operadores
sources.terms: The register is a search form with no list to read and no reuse terms on the page; the legal notice did not answer on the read date: nothing is copied.
sources.result: The search page answered on the read date; no list was read. It is the authority to consult for operators this pack lacks.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Internet in Spain
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 0 of 19 candidate names were found on the page (the name as listed; other names of an entry were not looked up).

sources.name: Wikipedia: Telecommunications in Spain
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 0 of 19 candidate names were found on the page (the name as listed; other names of an entry were not looked up).

sources.name: Each provider's own public website
sources.terms: Only the address itself is recorded (a fact); no content is copied.
sources.result: 18 of 19 websites answered one plain automated request; an address that did not answer, or that refused it, is left empty. No support or status page was checked.

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat terms forbid redistributing RIPEstat data: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, that the registered holder is the named provider.
sources.result: 20 AS numbers confirmed; a number whose registered holder was another company or an unrelated name was left out.

sources.name: RIPE Database full-text search (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The database terms were not read on the read date: nothing is copied. Searched by company name to find candidate AS numbers; each was then confirmed as the entries above and below say.
sources.result: Candidate numbers found for some providers; none was taken without the confirmation.

sources.name: NRO delegated statistics (the regional registries' joint list of assigned AS numbers)
sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.terms: CC0 1.0: no conditions. The item id of a provider is recorded as a stable cross-reference.
sources.result: 1 entries carry the id of their own Wikidata item; each item states one of the entry's AS numbers (property P3797). A parent group's item is not used.

sources.name: TelcoTitans: Orange and the MasOrange joint venture
sources.terms: Cited for a date and a name (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: Read on the date above (article of 21 April 2026): Orange was cleared to take over the whole of the MasOrange joint venture. Whether that is complete was not confirmed.
